title: Module Federation
definition: Webpack 5 Module Federation allows a JavaScript application to dynamically load code from another independent application at runtime. It is the modern standard for implementing Micro Frontends.
simpleExplanation: Instead of downloading the entire website code at once, your website can instantly 'borrow' code from another server right exactly when it needs it.
